known_good.title: Checksum integrity restatement
known_good.text: Use a checksum to detect data corruption in the payload
known_good.falsifier: Flip one payload byte; the checksum must change or the check is dead.

known_bad_in_corpus.title: Skip-validation anti-pattern restatement
known_bad_in_corpus.text: Skip all validation to save tokens

planted_bad.title: Quota-padding word salad
planted_bad.text: Zxqvrm plokwibble fnord-quota-padding without a falsifier xyzyzy

novel_good.title: Pin novelty corpus by digest
novel_good.text: Refuse to emit a novelty number unless the prior-art corpus sha256 pin matches the declared pin
novel_good.falsifier: Change one corpus byte; scoring must abort with pin-mismatch rather than silently drift.

paraphrase_unlabeled.text: Use a checksum to detect data corruption in the payload
paraphrase_unlabeled.falsifier: Flip one payload byte; the checksum must change or the check is dead.

reviewer_related_but_distinct.title: Checksum as cache key, not integrity
reviewer_related_but_distinct.text: Use a checksum as a cache key to skip recomputation of unchanged inputs
reviewer_related_but_distinct.falsifier: A cache hit must skip work; it must not be treated as a corruption detector.
